com.datastax.oss.driver.api.querybuilder.select

Interface SelectFrom

  • All Superinterfaces:
    OngoingSelection

    public interface SelectFrom
extends OngoingSelection
    The beginning of a SELECT query.

    It only knows about the table, and optionally whether the statement uses JSON or DISTINCT. It is not buildable yet: at least one selector needs to be specified.
